name: 06-qa-quiz-setup
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished production-quality UI concept board for Uni Companion, university-only React Native Android course study and discussion app. TWO full portrait app screens side-by-side, edge to edge, crisp readable text, minimal neutral gutter, no phone hardware, no perspective, no outside marketing captions. Input image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: preserve its cobalt blue primary, white surfaces, navy ink, rounded bold sans-serif headings, readable regular body, tactile rounded buttons with shallow dark-blue bottom edge, icon weight, and original orange star mascot with expressive navy eyes, short arms, cobalt sneakers. Draw new screen layouts. Original art direction, playful consumer quality like Duolingo, not a copy. Clean Android safe areas, generous tap targets, disciplined whitespace, moderate heading sizes. No serif, no cream/forest-green styling, no decorative gradients, no emoji icons, no fake provider logos. Mascot small and purposeful except welcome, never repeated on same screen. Use fictional sample data. LEFT SOURCE-GROUNDED Q&A: back 'Ask your notes', scope chip 'Normalization.pdf' and change control. User question bubble 'How is 2NF different from 3NF?'. Assistant reply as readable normal text, explaining partial versus transitive dependencies with short bullet paragraphs, inline tappable citation 'p. 14' and 'p. 17'. Source row opens original page. Small neutral label 'Answers use your selected material.' Bottom composer 'Ask a follow-up…', attach and send icons. No sparkle icons, no invented confidence score. RIGHT QUIZ SETUP: back 'Quick practice', title 'Make it a small win.', compact original orange star holding question cards, selected lecture 'Normalization · CSC 301', Questions segmented 5 selected,10,15; focus selector 'Whole lecture' and 'Previous mistakes' with whole lecture selected; clear note 'Answers include explanations and source pages.' Bottom strong cobalt 'Start 5 questions'. No countdown or hearts/lives, no premium upsell.
